<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Delimitation and quota push:</strong> The Union Cabinet has approved a constitutional amendment to increase Lok Sabha seats by 50% while linking the expansion to a 33% reservation for women, setting the stage for a contentious special Parliament session starting November 30.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPWHBWdFZ2T0g5V1NmNjVkNmNMU0RpWldhRkJFOVBfMDJnYVFTdmtZRUtKb2lseFNZYW9JZ1JXZ0poNG5LY3pBemtjVmRRS0ZkQ0lYa0QwbWJMMGxpY0hET2RHbFVnTFItd1FQUGdfZ2UzazN0MGp4WmZHM0ZSUGJia2sxeFU1bmQ3UWRlLTNTalJYM1hnRC1CYkdJcXR4SDhhR0psWWt1SQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I29</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition divide:</strong> While the INDIA bloc is rallying to oppose the bills, the opposition remains fractured as some parties like the NCP(SP) have signaled support for the delimitation measures, complicating efforts to present a united front.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative strategy:</strong> The Centre has urged MPs to ensure a smooth session for these &quot;very important bills,&quot; while Congress and other opposition parties have issued whips to their members to ensure attendance and coordinate their parliamentary strategy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
</ul>
